All.name: Advanced Weapon Training
All.description:
You've always been fascinated with unique, advanced weapons. 
Your proficiency level with one advanced weapon increases (max Trained)
Your proficiency level with Warfare Lore or Crafting increases (max Trained)

All.name: Clawfighter
All.description:
You have trained in fighting with your claws. 
You gain [Martial Arts Training] Feat

All.name: Coil Up
All.description:
You learned to coil your body up, to later move in burst of speed.
You have the Coil Up action
All.unlockedAction:
Coil Up - 1 Action
Next turn you may Step or Stride once as free action. 
If you move or are knocked prone, this bonus is lost

All.name: Combat Regeneration
All.description:
You've learned how to use your regenerative abilities in combat.
You learn the Combat Regeneration action
All.unlockedAction:
Combat Regeneration - 2 Action
Use one of regeneration charges
You cannot use this if you took fire, lightning or acid damage since your last turn

All.name: Drums of War
All.description:
Music is important to the Brannur and you've learned the tools of your people. Your proficiency level in Performance increases (max Expert). 
You have the Drums of War action.
All.unlockedAction:
Drums of War - 1 Action - Can be used once per Day 
Make a warchant to hype yourself and your allies up for battle. 
You and allies within 5 tiles gain temporary hit points equal to your WIL plus half your level which last up to a minute

All.name: Elven Blood
All.description:
The elves might be gone but you still have a drop of their blood in your ancestry.
You have resistance 3 + half your level to cold damage.
You have advantage on saves against illusions

All.name: Powerful Wingflap
All.description:
Aruna wings don't generally provide enough lift to fly, but with enough strength and the right technique you can temporary take off.
You have the Take Off action. You can use it a number of times equal to PHY each day.
All.unlockedAction:
Take Off - 1 Action
Fly a number of spaces equal to your glide speed

All.name: Forest Stalker
All.description:
You've trained to fight and hunt in the forests and jungles of you homeland
Your proficiency level in Stealth increases (max Expert)
Your proficiency level with the Bows weapon group increases (max Trained)

All.name: Formation Fighting
All.description:
You have fought shoulder to shoulder with your allies.
You have a +1 bonus to melee strikes and spell attacks when adjacent to at least two allies

All.name: Fruits of Civilization
All.description:
The Draconium is the center of civilization and your pride comes it's glory
When you use Proud Bearing the bonus increases to 3 if you are expert in the check, 4 for master and 5 for legendary
You can use Proud Bearing one more time per day.

All.name: Jungle Swimmer
All.description:
You've grown up swimming in the many rivers and lakes of your homeland. 
You have a 4 tile Swim Speed

All.name: Lesser Dragonbreath
All.description:
You've learned to use your attunement to imitate the breath of your draconic ancestor. 
You gain the Dragonbreath action, breathing out a cone of magic connected to your attunement
All.unlockedAction:
Dragonbreath - 2 Action, 7 mana
Breathe out a 5 tile cone of elemental force. 
Creatures inside the cone need to make a basic Reflex save. 
On a failure they take 3d6 damage.

All.name: Marsh Walker
All.description:
You've learned to navigate the wet and dangerous grounds of your homeland. 
You ignore difficult terrain caused by wetlands, swamps, jungles and similar. 
You have +3 bonus to Survival and Nature checks regarding those environments.

All.name: Powerful Tail
All.description:
You can use your powerful tail to block incoming attacks and whack foes
Your tail is a natural weapon that deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage.
It has the Block 1 and Shove traits.

All.name: Resilience
All.description:
You won't go down when most would fall.
Once per day when you would be reduced to zero health, stay at 1 health instead

All.name: Sensitive Nose
All.description:
While all Yirte have a greater sense of smell than most, you have trained your nose beyond that. 
You have an imprecise sense of smell, which you can use to try find creatures or objects. 
Your proficiency level in Perception increases (max Expert)

All.name: Sha'des'ka Practioner
All.description:
You trained in the ancient Naga art of Sha'des'ka, or its modern form Arcane Dueling. 
You gain the [Duelist] Feat

All.name: Subterranean Experize
All.description:
You've learned all you can about the depths you call home and can navigate them with ease
Your proficiency level with Depths Below Lore increases (max Expert)
You ignore difficult terrain from natural rocks and earthen formations

All.name: Updraft Glider
All.description:
You ignore difficult terrain from harsh winds and airborne obstacles
You take half the normal penalty on aiming through smoke

All.name: Waters of the isles
All.description:
You've grown up swimming around the waters of Te'ohuvi and learned of creatures there.
You have a 3 tile Swim Speed
You have a +2 bonus on nature and survival checks connected to aquatic creatures

All.name: Lesser Pseudo-Attunement
All.description:
While gnomes, can't have a normal attunement you have absorbed some elemental energies from your environment, giving you something similar
Gain the Basic Elemental Magic Feat.
You have small visible connections to your elements. This might patches of stone for an Earth Pseudo-Attunement or hair that flows like water for a Water one

All.name: Spellward
All.description:
You've learned some of the old techniques used by the Spear's Legacy mercenary company to fight battlemages
You have a +1 bonus to all saves against spells

All.name: Inspiring Presence
All.description:
Your pride inspires your companions.
After you use Proud Bearing up to 5 nearby allies gets +1 to their next roll. This bonus increases to +2 if you succeed on the roll, or +3 if you critically succeed.
You can use Proud Bearing one more time per day.

All.name: Lightning Strike
All.description:
You take advantage of the speed from Coil Up to hit foes that aren't expecting it.
After you use the free Step or Stride from Coil Up, your next Strike that turn has a +2 attack bonus

All.name: Strong Blood
All.description: You can use your Regeneration trait once more per day

All.name: Winged Dragonkin
All.description:
You've been chosen to undergo the ritual of Wings. 
This ritual is generally only granted to high ranking Dragonkin of the Draconium. 
Your new draconic wings grants you a 5 tile flying speed.
